body:
Know Your Dose
I had intended on having this experience alone the following morning but a friend really wanted to try it so I gave in. I had forgotten how much I had loaded into each capsule so I weighed them, four in total. I then I looked up the recommended dose chart and realized that for the two of us it would be a really light dose 125mg each. I told my friend that it would be about an hour before we felt anything so get comfortable.
We took it at 1:11 am, ten minutes in I thought I already felt it coming on and thought it was just my imagination.When it hit me only 34min had elapsed and I thought that was a bit strange. I picked up my phone and looked at the chart I had referenced earlier. I was shocked to see at the top of the chart it said Mescaline!!
I picked up my phone and looked at the chart I had referenced earlier. I was shocked to see at the top of the chart it said Mescaline!!
I had looked at the wrong dosing chart! I turned and looked at my friend and asked if he was feeling anything? He looked back at me with huge pupils and said Hell ya I am! I just said I may have made a mistake on the dosing so we are probably going to go on one hell of a ride, hang on tight!!The following is the best I could do as the experience was quite intense, and it was very difficult to see my phone or try to type anything on it as everything was liquid.
1:45am Feeling it already
1:51am body buz tingling auditory distortion
1:57am feels like my whole body needs to yawn and I cant stretch enough
2:00am feels like the come up on shrooms.  No visuals but everything seems clear and crisp
2:03am 2:04 already getting hard to keep a train of thought phone is morphing a lot.
2:10 feeling fucking amazing
2:12 pretty sure Ive lost my mind
2:17 this shit cant make up its mind
2:26 friend is feeling nauseous threw up?
2:28 its already difficult to keep one train of thought
2:31 mdma like feel body feels great
2:32 I think Ive lost my minds as
2:33 seeing shit for sure
2:52 forgot who I was tripping with
4:25 howd we get here
4:45 basically all motor skills not working
6:26 Jesus Christ
7:00 feel like I can sleep going to give it a try
11:00 laid there and fell asleep finally. Its now
7am the following morning. I slept away all of Sunday and teleported directly into Monday morning. It was a great experience overall.
[Reported Dose: "123 mg"]
